message.content: {"memo": "The filing reports net loss of $80,748m for the six months ended June 30, 2026. It reports Adjusted Net Income (Loss) of $2,671m for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The difference adds back stock-based compensation expense of $2,185m for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and non-cash charitable contributions of $126m for the six months ended June 30, 2026. It also adds back change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs of $72,388m for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and change in fair value of certain mark-to-market financial instruments of $8,720m for the six months ended June 30, 2026.", "next_questions": ["What is the Bartz settlement?", "What drove the mark-to-market change?", "How is Adjusted Operating Income defined?"]}
